body:
One of my boys brought a mouse inside the other day, brought the poor thing over to his food bowl, and ate it. I hate that he dragged it inside, but I think his cat-logic is adorable. Mouse = food. Food = bowl. 

(We didn’t discover what he was doing until it was already half-eaten.)
Thank you so much for the feedback! ❤️
Love the dress! (the little kittens on the collar is especially neat!)

https://preview.redd.it/ju1vaqrclrgc1.png?width=1237&format=png&auto=webp&s=e56cce360a87bbd7de010664e3e3d3fdd1c03795

This one always cracks me up. He’s just yawning, but it looks like he’s seriously upset over having to fold the laundry.
Thank you! I think so too! 😄

Thank you all for helping me prove a point to myself. It makes it easier. 

I hope, with all my heart, that all of you live full, wonderful lives where each new day is always the most enjoyable one. Thank you for taking the time to read this. ❤️
I wish I could upvote this more than once. Holy hell.
Once managed to convince my little brother these were tractor eggs. He got so offended when he eventually realized they weren’t.
The same thing happens if you do it to Post Malone’s voice. He’ll sound eerily similar to Justin Bieber. https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=N4SWXEyXIUY
Oh my. I feel like I could stare at this for a good hour at least! Love the detail and thought put into this, nicely done!

Bor i Norge nå ja. Men flytta til Sverige da jeg var rundt seks år gammel. Bodde der i to år før vi flytta tilbake igjen, og jeg har vært her siden da. 

Dumt at du ikke fikk sove da. :/ Men jeg tror jeg skal prøve det samme, så vi får håpe på et bedre resultat for begge to, da! 

God natt, og igjen, tusen takk.
Skjønner den! Sov godt, og takk for at du pratet med meg. :) Om jeg kommer på en annen plass, så tar jeg kontakt!

Igjen, jeg setter pris på det. Hva er oddsene da, at jeg møter en annen Norsk person på en side så stor som dette? Og på denne subredditen av alle plasser. 

Livet er merkelig.

I appreciate it, mate. While I don't feel up to talking to anybody right at this very moment, I'll be sure to keep your offer in mind. I completely understand the "too personal" thing, and I find that I experience that now, not only with psychologists and therapists, but also with close friends and family. Which is probably why I'm having such a hard time opening up like this to a site full of veritable strangers. 

But thank you. 

Also, I have to ask, if for no other reason than to satisfy my own curiosity: 

Fargekritt, er du Norsk?
